messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "patients with low levels of magnesium, calcium, or potassium in blood"
set: ["patients with low levels of magnesium, calcium, or potassium in blood", "low potassium levels", "low potassium or low sodium levels", "blood potassium levels", "low levels of phosphate in the blood", "low blood sodium levels", "low blood sugar levels", "signs of low potassium", "low potassium", "electrolyte imbalance (such as low levels of potassium or magnesium in your blood)", "low levels of sodium in the body", "low potassium can be managed with potassium supplements", "low oxygen levels", "low cortisol levels", "tell doctor if have or had low sodium levels in blood", "metoprolol levels in blood"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
